scientific_integrity: The proof gives an exact two-color variance optimizer using the standard known Rademacher variance identity; finite rational checks are corroborative, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies to two independent Rademacher probes, the shifted combinatorial Laplacian inverse of complete bipartite graphs, fixed two-quadratic-form cost, and variance; independent publication-precedence validation is not available.
title: Sharp two-color stochastic-probing transition on complete bipartite resolvents
